basic_info.description: 828 Ashbury is an elegant 4 story historic residence with three sensational living levels, lovely 1910 period detail throughout, and a perfect family-friendly floor plan. Developed by Mary A. Fritz, the home sits on an elevated site above the street, showcasing brilliant natural light and privacy while standing tall amongst its impressive neighbors.  A gorgeous wood staircase connects the home, creating a feeling of intimacy and solace. The layout offers five generous bedrooms, three-and-a-half bathrooms, a grand living room, a fabulous wood-paneled dining room with fireplace, a beautiful eat-in kitchen with Carrera marble countertops and island, custom wood cabinetry, high-end stainless appliances, plus a walkout garden.   Rest easy in the expansive primary bedroom, boasting sublime features designed for a truly luxurious living experience. Enjoy a tranquil, light-filled sleeping area, abundant closet space, a gorgeous marbled bath, a stall shower, and a dual vanity with Waterworks fixtures. Down the hall are another two bedrooms and an updated hall bath. On the top level are two additional bedrooms, which could be flex space for an office, media room, or au pair. Below t is a laundry room, tons of storage space, a game room/den, and a massive 2-3 car garage w/ moment frame.
